svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
A fire alarm system is installed in buildings in which a
sprinkler system is required by this Part
Except as permitted in Sentences (3) and (4).
A fire alarm system is installed in every building that
contains more than 3 storeys, including storeys below
the first storey, where the total occupant load exceeds
300, or when the occupant load for any major occupancy
in Table 9.10.18.2. is exceeded
Except as provided in Sentence (5). The Table is in cell C.
In buildings with a sprinkler system installed in
accordance with NFPA 13D, a fire alarm system need not
be installed
NFPA 13D, "Standard for the Installation of Sprinkler
Systems in One- and Two-Family Dwellings and Manufactured
Homes."
In buildings that contain fewer than 9 sprinklers
conforming to Sentence 3.2.5.12.(4), a fire alarm system
need not be installed
Sentence 3.2.5.12.(4) lets fewer than 9 sprinklers be
supplied from the domestic water system, provided the
required flow can be met.
A fire alarm system is not required in a residential
occupancy where an exit or public corridor serves not
more than 4 suites
Or where each suite has direct access to an exterior exit
facility leading to ground level.
Drawn: A with the ground cut away, B a floor plan with walls cut low. Sizes are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.18.2. (page 9-96), with Sentence 3.2.5.12.(4)
